meta.title: Tenses Test B1 & B2 (Correction) - Indonesian Culture
meta.description: A comprehensive test covering English tenses themed around Indonesian culture, combining at least two or more tenses per question.
meta.info: This test includes 30 correction-type questions focusing on combined B1-B2 level grammar structures involving multiple English tenses, featuring cultural elements like Batik, Wayang, Borobudur, Rendang, and more.

explanation.text: This combines the Past Continuous ('was applying') for an ongoing past action, the Past Perfect ('had used') for an action completed before that past realization, and the Past Simple ('started') for the subsequent past action.
explanation.topic: Past Continuous + Past Perfect + Past Simple

examples: While she was drawing, she realized she had used the wrong color, so she started again.
